name: UV Protection Sunglasses
description: Premium UV protection sunglasses designed to shield your eyes from harmful UVA and UVB rays. Features a lightweight yet durable frame, polarized lenses for reduced glare, and a stylish modern design suitable for beach outings, driving, and everyday summer wear.

name: Beach Hat
description: Wide brim beach hat crafted from breathable and lightweight materials to keep you cool under the sun. Offers excellent sun protection for your face and neck while adding a stylish touch to your summer outfit. Ideal for beach trips, vacations, and outdoor activities.

name: Summer T-Shirt
description: Comfortable and breathable cotton t-shirt perfect for hot summer days. Designed with moisture-wicking fabric to keep you cool and dry. Soft texture, modern fit, and versatile style make it ideal for casual wear, travel, and daily use.

name: Flip Flops
description: Lightweight and comfortable flip flops designed for all-day wear. Features a soft cushioned sole, non-slip grip, and durable straps. Perfect for beach outings, poolside relaxation, and casual summer activities.

name: Sunscreen SPF 50
description: High-performance SPF 50 sunscreen that provides broad-spectrum protection against harmful UV rays. Water-resistant formula suitable for all skin types. Helps prevent sunburn, premature aging, and skin damage while keeping your skin hydrated and protected during outdoor activities.

name: Water Bottle
description: Durable and reusable water bottle designed to keep you hydrated throughout the day. Made from BPA-free materials, leak-proof design, and easy to carry. Ideal for gym, travel, office, and outdoor summer activities.

name: Swim Goggles
description: High-quality swim goggles with anti-fog lenses for clear underwater vision. Designed with adjustable straps and a comfortable seal to prevent water leakage. Perfect for swimming, diving, and pool training sessions.

name: Sun Cap
description: Lightweight and breathable sun cap designed to provide protection from direct sunlight. Features an adjustable strap for a comfortable fit and a curved brim for better shade. Ideal for outdoor activities, sports, and casual wear.

name: Beach Bag
description: Spacious beach bag for all your essentials.
